# MindStep — Strategic Cognitive Training & Memory Puzzle Game

> MindStep is an interactive web-based puzzle game for training spatial memory, strategic logic, and cognitive awareness. Players navigate a dynamic grid moving like a chess queen while avoiding hidden memory traps.

## Main Pages

- [Play MindStep (Game Entry)](https://alik532ua.github.io/MindStep/): Mode selection and the start of a game.
- [Rules & How to Play](https://alik532ua.github.io/MindStep/rules): Movement rules, traps, scoring and win conditions.
- [Controls & Hotkeys](https://alik532ua.github.io/MindStep/controls): Keyboard, mouse and touch input reference.
- [Settings](https://alik532ua.github.io/MindStep/settings): Board size, themes, language, speech and accessibility options.
- [Rewards](https://alik532ua.github.io/MindStep/rewards): Achievements and progression unlocked by play.
- [Local Two-Player Setup](https://alik532ua.github.io/MindStep/local-setup): Configuring a pass-and-play match on one device.
- [Online Multiplayer](https://alik532ua.github.io/MindStep/online): Creating and joining real-time matches.
- [Supporters](https://alik532ua.github.io/MindStep/supporters): Credits and people who backed the project.

## Game Modes & Features

- Single Player Mode: Progressive challenge with virtual opponents and customizable grid sizes (4x4, 5x5, 6x6).
- Blindfold Mode (Наосліп): Hardcore cognitive training where visited trap locations disappear from view.
- 2-Player Hotseat: Local pass-and-play turn-based competition on a single device.
- Online Multiplayer: Real-time matches over Firebase Realtime Database.
- Offline & PWA support: Fully functional offline with automatic state persistence.

## Technical Details

- Built with SvelteKit 2 and Svelte 5 runes.
- Fully accessible with full keyboard navigation and high-contrast theme support.
- Client-side execution; no personal data is collected.
